comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum contract term and no notice period. You can cancel whenever you like; the fee is charged monthly in advance, and you keep access until the end of the month you paid for.
comparison.faq.termQ: Is there a minimum contract term?
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a till system and is not certified under tax rules. How to record online orders in your till system is something to check with your accountant.
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes online orders before customers reach the food truck: they choose the dishes and a pickup time, pay online or at pickup, and the order shows up in your kitchen. A till system or a card terminal (POS) takes payment at the truck. The two complement each other.
